title: Australia’s Santos Signs Two Separate LNG Agreements With POSCO Steel and Western LNG
dek: Australia's Santos has signed two separate LNG agreements, one with POSCO and one with Western LNG, EnergyNow.com reports.
summary: According to EnergyNow.com, Australia's Santos has signed two separate LNG agreements, with POSCO and with Western LNG. The publisher provided no excerpt, so volumes, duration and pricing are not stated.
keyFacts: Santos signed two separate LNG agreements
Counterparties are POSCO and Western LNG
whyItMatters: Gas supply is increasingly relevant to steelmakers as a fuel and as a potential bridge to lower-emission ironmaking routes.
implications: The deal may support POSCO's energy security; the excerpt gives no terms to assess its scale.
